corrections.old_text: ፩ዜዋ ፪ ፬ ፡ ሩት ፬ ፲፰ ፡ ፳ጎ↵
corrections.corrected_text: ፩ዜዋ ፪ ፬ ፡ ሩት ፬ ፲፰ ፡ ሉቃ
corrections.reason: Canonical biblical cross-reference for Perez and Zerah in the genealogy of Christ is Luke 3:33 (ሉቃ ፫ ፴፫); 'ሉቃ' was misread as '፳ጎ'.
The mark before ፫ ፴፫ is a printer's ornament/smudge, not the letter ዑ continuing from the previous line.
Classical Ge'ez construct active participle 'ከዓዌ ዘርእ' (spiller of seed, Gen 38:9) uses 1st-order ከ and 5th-order ዌ.
Amharic verb 'ሄዳለች' is printed with 5th-order ሄ (loop at bottom right), misread as 3rd-order ሂ.
Amharic 1st person perfect 'ሄድሁ' is printed with 5th-order ሄ, misread as 3rd-order ሂ.
Amharic temporal clause 'ባየች ጊዜ' (when she saw, Gen 38:14) requires 4th-order ባ ('በ + አየች'), visually confirmed by the shorter right leg of ባ.
Amharic infinitive 'መሄድ' uses 5th-order ሄ, misread as 3rd-order ሂ.
Standard Amharic 3rd-person feminine singular perfect 'ሞተችበት' is printed with 1st-order ተ (two equal legs), misread as 4th-order ታ.
Canonical Ge'ez citation of Gen 38:17 reads 'እፈኑ ለኪ ፩ መሐስዓ ጠሊ' (a kid of the goats) with 1st-order መ and ሐ.
The word wrapping from L08 ('መ↵ያዣ', pledge) has the wide glyph ዣ on L09, which was split and misread as 'ገዮ' (compare 'መያዣ' on L12).
Amharic discourse particle 'እንኪያስ' begins with 6th-order እ, misread as 1st-order አ.
